test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.

Which films __have you seen__ when you were in Meerut?
solution:
The correct answer is **'did you see'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• After reading the sentence, we get to know that the sentence is in **the past tense.**
 
• The phrase *'when you were in Meerut'* **proves **that the sentence is in** past completely -** **'Past Indefinite Tense'.**
 
• **In the Past Indefinite Tense (interrogative sentences)**, we generally **use 'did + verb 1st form'.**
 
• So the sentence would be - ***Which films did you see when you were in Meerut?***

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's **understand **the concept with **some more examples:**

__
 
• *Why **did__** you __**ignore **__me when you were at the party?*
 
• *How __**did **__the robber __**enter **__when you were there in the room?*
 
• *Why __**did **__you not __**meet**__ your relatives when you were in your hometown?*
